translationRepairs: Focus unit 伊尹曰 names 伊尹; uncapitalized English “yiyin” is an orthographic error, and “Yi Yin” correctly renders the personal name while leaving the rest of the sentence unchanged.
伊尹名阿衡 uses 名 (“was named”), not a style-name formula such as 字; capitalizing Yi Yin and replacing “styled” with “named” both match the Chinese.
Wuxian brought order to the royal house and composed Salted Mugwort and Taiwu.
Wuxian brought order to the royal house and composed Xian Ai and Taiwu.
作咸艾，作太戊 is the parallel document-composition formula (cf. 作原命 in s0107); “Salted Mugwort” invents a food sense for the title 咸艾, and “Xian Ai” correctly treats it as a work title.
He named Western Earl Chang, the Nine Marquises, and the Marquis of E as the three high dukes.
He named Western Earl Chang, the Marquis of Jiu, and the Marquis of E as the three high dukes.

以西伯昌、九侯、鄂侯為三公 lists three singular lords as the three dukes; 九侯 is one titled individual parallel to 鄂侯, not a plural “Nine Marquises,” as the following units’ daughter and execution narrative confirm.
The Marquis of E disputed it strongly, argued it swiftly; together he pickled the Marquis of E.
The Marquis of E disputed it strongly and argued it swiftly; Zhou also pickled the Marquis of E.

Continuing from 紂怒……醢九侯, 并脯鄂侯 has Zhou as the agent of 脯 and 并 as “also”; the before wrongly makes the Marquis pickle himself. The proposal’s agent fix is right, but bracketed “[Zhou]” is editorial markup, so the revised literal names Zhou in natural English.
